mentions.h: FROM 'The Belgravian' 25 years ago and 40 years ago
mentions.note: Belgian, joined Belgrave 1943 after escaping occupied Europe; first marathoner into Wembley Stadium at the 1948 London Olympics but passed on the track; died in a motor accident in Belgium in 1971

mentions.h: FROM THE BELGRAVIAN 25 years ago... and 40 years ago...
mentions.note: 3rd in the 1948 Olympic marathon for Belgium

Belgium; first into Wembley Stadium in the 1948 Olympic Marathon but passed, finishing third for the bronze medal; trained and competed for Belgrave during the war; later killed in a car accident; annual marathon in Belgium in his honour
Belgian; ran with Belgrave cross-country teams during the war; first into Wembley Stadium in the 1948 Olympic marathon but passed; later killed in a car-crash
Olympic marathon 1948; had run for Belgrave while in England in the Army

mentions.h: P.W. "Jimmy" Green: A man of many talents
mentions.note: Belgian who very nearly won the 1948 Olympic Marathon
Belgian; elected Belgrave member 29 April 1944; 1948 Belgian Marathon Champion; 1948 Olympic Marathon; 3rd, 1948 Olympic Marathon, 2:35:33.6; wounded in Korea November 1951

photos.c: A shattered Etienne Gailly is led away from the finish of the Olympic Marathon of 1948.

The final 400 metres— "It was like the progress of a martyr". Etienne, wearing 252, is passed by the Argentinian Delfo Cabrera and Tom Richards of Britain will also overtake him in a few more seconds.

photo.caption: A shattered Etienne Gailly is led away from the finish of the Olympic Marathon of 1948.
